taxonomic_note: Modern Gaura/Oenothera revision supports the accepted Oenothera filiformis concept. Nearby Comal type/locality records of other Oenothera taxa are not transferred into this species.
look_here_first: Start with the tall airy gaura-like habit: a robust winter annual or sometimes biennial with white asymmetric 4-petaled flowers that fade pink, long floral tubes, and a long-exserted style.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays and Travis are locked under a compatible modern taxon concept. A third exact target-zone county was not recovered; Comal records encountered in the revision belong to other Oenothera taxa.

approval_exception.reason: Learner admission is independent from native-range certification. Preserve the two-county HOLD and do not infer a third county.

best_field_traits: usually robust winter annual, sometimes biennial
morphology_keys.comparison_training: O. calcicola is perennial with a woody rootstock and strong limestone specialization; O. filiformis is usually annual/biennial and generally taller and airier.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Life history and rootstock are important: annual/biennial airy O. filiformis versus perennial woody-rooted O. calcicola.
